text: SparkNote（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：让你在阅读 DSH 回复时做彩色标注，并把回复连同对应问题一起收藏。它为已完成的文本回复添加收藏入口，在侧栏提供可搜索的收藏面板，并通过选中文字后的工具栏添加、改色或移除高亮。收藏会保存回复文本、问题和标注，之后可阅读、搜索、重命名收藏并返回来源会话。适合想整理 DSH 对话中的重点答案、保留问题上下文并稍后查找的人。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web；不需要额外 API 密钥。

SparkNote (DSH Web) lets you highlight completed replies and save them with their questions. Collect an answer with its reply action, then search or read saved items in the sidebar collection. Select text to add, recolor, or remove highlights. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web; no API key needed.
想把 DSH 回复里重要的句子标上颜色，之后还能找到。
有没有办法把回答和我当时问的问题一起收藏起来？
I want to search my saved DSH answers and their highlights later.
SparkNote 的功能「回复彩色高亮」：在已完成的回复文本中选择一段文字，再从工具栏选择黄色、绿色、蓝色或粉色；点击已有标注可改色或移除，标记会显示在原回复文本上。
SparkNote 的功能「收藏并搜索回复」：点击已完成回复下方的星形入口，可将完整回复、对应问题和现有标注保存到收藏；在侧栏 Collection 中按回复、问题或高亮文字搜索，打开条目阅读、重命名或返回来源会话。
dsh-sparknote 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 21 天；提交数 9；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-sparknote README · SparkNote：[中文](README.zh.md) | [English](README.md)

> **Compatibility:** plugin `0.1.3` requires **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` · Web**.
>
> `package.json` pins `engines.dsh` to this exact version. Other DSH versions, including newer releases, and Desktop installation have not been verified.

dsh-sparknote README · Summary：Highlight replies while reading, then collect the whole reply with all its marks. Highlights save automatically before collection. The collection keeps a copy of the reply so it remains readable after its source session is deleted. This optional bundle adds a collection to your Web profile.

dsh-sparknote README · Screenshots：These screenshots show the Chinese UI in a local sample conversation; the plugin supports both Chinese and English. Highlight as you read: select text and choose a color before collecting. Browse saved replies by conversation name and reply opening. Open a collection to read the saved user question, reply, and colored highlights together.

dsh-sparknote README · Use this package：Install SparkNote `0.1.3` through the Plugins page or run this command for your Web profile, then restart DSH Web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/zzh-github/dsh-plugin-sparknote/releases/download/v0.1.3/dsh-sparknote-0.1.3.tgz
```

dsh-sparknote README · Use this package：Select text in a completed reply and choose yellow, green, blue, or pink. Click an existing highlight to change or remove it. The five-point star below the reply collects its full Markdown, existing highlights, and the corresponding user question by default. The default title combines the conversation name with the opening of the reply; you can rename it afterward. Open Collection in the sidebar to search reply text, saved questions, and highlights, rename a collection, read, edit highlights, or open the source conversation. Saved replies show colored highlights directly on their original text, including selections across Markdown blocks. The Manage highlights section stays collapsed until you open it to browse quotes or use its controls. Removing a collection keeps its highlight draft.

dsh-sparknote README · Use this package：Changes show as saved only after the Host commits them. A failed operation keeps existing data and offers Retry. Data is stored under the Harness home using the profile's configured storage provider. Unloading the bundle removes its UI without deleting its data.

For plugin development, run `pnpm install`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm run pack:bundle` in this directory. The bundle has its own lockfile and does not modify the Harness workspace dependency graph.

dsh-sparknote README · Use this package：This directory is an independent Git repository. Run plugin Git commands here and Harness Git commands in the DSH checkout. To prepare a keyless recorded-session check, run `pnpm run prepare:smoke --dsh-root D:/00-code/DSH`; omission of `--dsh-root` uses the sibling `DSH` directory. The script prints isolated test paths and does not start a server.

dsh-sparknote README · Understand the implementation：The profile patch mounts one Host plugin and its browser contribution. The Host validates owner-only RPC requests and serializes mutations to versioned storage records. The browser uses additive Chat, sidebar, main-panel, and overlay slots. A release-specific DOM adapter maps text selections to completed Chat nodes and paints CSS Custom Highlights without modifying React-owned content. Exact quotes and surrounding text locate highlights after layout changes, with separator-newline differences mapped back to the rendered text; ambiguous matches remain unpainted and their saved quotes remain available.

dsh-sparknote README · Model Experience：This bundle contributes no model tools or prompt content. Collections and annotations are private reading data and do not enter the model context.

dsh-sparknote README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：The user question must be loaded in the current Chat history before you can collect its reply. Question attachments are not copied. Older collections without a saved question remain readable and show a notice. Only completed text replies with a standard action row are supported. Streaming replies, reasoning, images, freehand drawing, and cross-message selections are excluded. Text highlighting needs a current browser with CSS Custom Highlight support. The DOM adapter is pinned to the declared DSH version; Desktop installation is unverified. Other browser windows refresh their collection when focused; live multi-window updates and collection export are not included. Opening the source returns to its conversation, without paging to the exact historical message.

dsh-sparknote README · Planned Features：The following features are planned and are not available in the current release: - Tags for organizing saved replies. - Category filtering. - Statistics by category. - Usage reports. - Notes on saved content and sharing. - Integration with third-party note-taking tools.

dsh-sparknote README · Community and contribution：This is an independently maintained community plugin. The DSH [contribution guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) asks plugin authors to add the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) GitHub repository topic so others can discover their work. Report plugin bugs and suggest improvements in [this repository's Issues](https://github.com/zzh-github/dsh-plugin-sparknote/issues).

dsh-sparknote README · Dev Note：Version `0.1.3` uses `sparknote` for its internal plugin ID and storage domain. Collections saved by `v0.1.2` or earlier local builds are not migrated and do not appear in this version.
